setup.title: Initial setup
setup.subtitle: Eight steps to a working shop
setup.errorTitle: The step could not be saved
setup.token.title: Setup token
setup.token.description: Enter the RR_SETUP_TOKEN value from your .env file.
setup.admin.title: Administrator
setup.admin.description: The shop owner's account. The password must be at least 12 characters.
setup.admin.totpHint: Scan the QR code in an authenticator app and enter the code.
setup.admin.totpAlt: QR code for an authenticator app
setup.domain.title: Domain
setup.domain.description: The shop domain and the certificate email, prefilled from .env.
setup.domain.dnsHint: Make sure the A record of {domain} points at this server: dig +short A {domain}
setup.panel.title: Panel
setup.panel.description: The Remnawave address and API token. Run the check before you continue.
setup.panel.webhookSecretHint: Enter the secret already configured in the panel. Leave blank to generate one.
setup.panel.extraHeadersHint: A JSON object such as "CF-Access-Client-Id": "…", one field per header.
setup.panel.webhook: Add these lines to the panel's .env
setup.bot.title: Bot
setup.bot.description: The bot token from @BotFather. The webhook is set on the last step.
setup.bot.supportChatHint: The group requests arrive in, like -100…; a forum is best — every customer gets a topic. The bot that writes there must be its administrator with the «Manage topics» right. You can set it later in «Settings» → «Support».
setup.bot.supportBotHint: A separate bot customers write to for support; the operators’ answers come from it. Empty keeps support in the shop bot.
setup.bot.siteLogin: Telegram sign-in on the site: in the @BotFather mini app open the bot → Login Widget, press «Switch to OpenID Connect Login», add the Redirect URIs https://{domain}/ru and https://{domain}/en and the Trusted Origin https://{domain}. The Client Secret is not needed.
setup.brand.title: Brand
setup.brand.name: Shop name
setup.plan.title: Plan and trial
setup.plan.description: The shop's first plan and the trial parameters.
setup.plan.squadsHint: The list was loaded from the panel on the Panel step.
setup.payments.title: Payments and receipts
setup.payments.description: Enable at least one provider or skip the step: Stars and the balance remain.
setup.payments.statusHint: Self-employed owners can use the npd receipt mode; without a status no receipts are issued.
setup.done.title: Ready
setup.done.description: Review the summary and launch the shop.
setup.done.removeToken: You can now remove RR_SETUP_TOKEN from .env.
setup.payments.hint.ipRanges: One range per line. Empty: the ranges YooKassa documents.
setup.payments.hint.additionalKey: The key Lava signs its webhooks with.
setup.payments.hint.starsPerRub: How many stars to charge per rouble of the price, e.g. 0.75.
setup.payments.hint.isTest: Payments go to Robokassa's test environment with the test passwords.
setup.plan.squadsMissing: The panel returned no squads. Create an internal squad in the panel and return to the «Panel» step: a plan without squads gives no access.
setup.panel.baseUrlHint: The address the panel opens at, such as https://panel.example.com. Without a scheme, https:// is assumed.
setup.brand.timezoneHint: Start typing a city, such as Europe/Moscow or Asia/Yekaterinburg; the bot and the site show dates in this zone.
